description: Source code defining an abstract class 'BrowserType' for launching and managing browser instances within the Playwright testing framework. It includes methods for launching browsers, handling processes, and managing browser contexts, with support for retries, environment setup, and transport connections.

classes.name: BrowserType
classes.description: Abstract class for browser launching and management within Playwright, providing core methods for process handling, connection, and context setup.

methods.name: executablePath
methods.description: Returns the executable path for the browser type based on registry lookup.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the browser type.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches a browser instance with specified options, handling retries and protocol logging.

methods.name: launchPersistentContext
methods.description: Launches a persistent browser context with user data directory and options, including proxy and TLS handling.

methods.name: _innerLaunchWithRetries
methods.description: Attempts to launch a browser with retries on specific errors.

methods.name: _innerLaunch
methods.description: Handles the core logic for launching a browser, process management, and establishing transport.

methods.name: _prepareToLaunch
methods.description: Prepares environment, directories, and arguments for launching the browser.

methods.name: _launchProcess
methods.description: Starts the browser process, manages signals, and sets up transport connection.

methods.name: _createArtifactDirs
methods.description: Creates directories for downloads and traces if specified.

methods.name: connectOverCDP
methods.description: Connects to a browser over Chrome DevTools Protocol (not supported for non-Chromium).

methods.name: _launchWithSeleniumHub
methods.description: Connects to a Selenium remote WebDriver (not supported for non-Chromium).

methods.name: _validateLaunchOptions
methods.description: Validates and adjusts launch options, e.g., headless mode and proxy settings.

methods.name: _createUserDataDirArgMisuseError
methods.description: Generates error message for incorrect userDataDir argument usage based on SDK language.

methods.name: _rewriteStartupLog
methods.description: Rewrites protocol errors for startup logs.

methods.name: waitForReadyState
methods.description: Waits for the browser to be ready, e.g., for WebSocket endpoint.

methods.name: prepareUserDataDir
methods.description: Hook for preparing user data directory before launch.

methods.name: supportsPipeTransport
methods.description: Indicates support for pipe transport.

methods.name: getExecutableName
methods.description: Returns the executable name based on options or default.

methods.name: defaultArgs
methods.description: Abstract method to get default launch arguments.

methods.name: connectToTransport
methods.description: Abstract method to connect to the browser transport.

methods.name: amendEnvironment
methods.description: Abstract method to amend environment variables for launch.

methods.name: doRewriteStartupLog
methods.description: Abstract method to rewrite startup protocol errors.

methods.name: attemptToGracefullyCloseBrowser
methods.description: Abstract method to attempt graceful browser closure.
